highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia m156 and restores Linux system-font discovery without bundled dependencies.
highlights_body: It also adds native GTK4 GPU rendering with pixel scaling and updates Tizen native builds for GCC 14.2.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 156 and includes the current upstream engine changes.

bullets.lead: Linux system-font discovery restored without bundled dependencies
bullets.detail: Linux NoDependencies deployments can again discover installed system fonts.

bullets.lead: GTK4 gains native GPU rendering and pixel scaling
bullets.detail: GTK4 applications can use native GPU rendering with scaling that tracks the display pixel density.

bullets.lead: Tizen native builds move to GCC 14.2
bullets.detail: Tizen 10 packages are built and validated with the GCC 14.2 toolchain.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments
